pages.text: Copper, glass, and a needle. The needle decides what is drawn: hold it in your $(l)off hand$() and $(l)sneak-use$() the syringe to fit it.$(br2)Use the syringe on a creature to draw one dram. It holds four. Use it in the air to empty it into a vial.
Gold tools are the quickest there are: it draws $(l)Speed$().
pages.title: Gold Needle

pages.text: Bone is the frame a body hangs on: it draws $(l)Size$().
pages.title: Bone Needle

pages.text: No needle I have made can hold $(l)Awareness$(). It evaporates the instant it meets glass. Only living tissue can take it: see $(l)The Living Machine$().
pages.title: Awareness
